_live_comment: P1 = paper only. Live deploy is a separate future phase once a spot venue is selected (Bitvavo / Kraken / Coinbase EU / OKX EU spot). The runner refuses to start if paper_only=false until a venue adapter is wired.
_cost_comment: Total round-trip cost on the *traded notional delta* at each rebalance. 20bps = 10bps in + 10bps out — covers maker fee + small slippage on a spot venue at this size. Make this configurable so we can calibrate to the chosen venue once selected.
_cycle_comment: Strategy is daily-decision; cycle is 1h so the dashboard stays fresh. Only one decision per UTC day — subsequent intra-day cycles just refresh price/equity.
_price_source_options: okx_spot_public | blofin_spot_public — both work, public market data, no auth needed
_fallback_doc: Per DECISIONS.md 2026-05-13 this is the documented fallback (BH + drawdown stop + vol-target) — NOT a demonstrated edge. STRATEGY-V1-RESULTS.md §3 records that the underlying trend rule did NOT clear the random-entry null gate (84th-percentile Calmar, inside the 5–95 band). The rationale to run it anyway is the marginal risk-adjusted improvement vs B1 BH on the 3.3-year series + EU-executability on spot only.
